flora: Mamaku Crozier (massive, jet-black coiled fiddlehead with thick black scales)
Black Stipe (close-up of the thick, dark, charcoal-black branch base)
Mamaku sapling (vigorous growth with black stems emerging from ash-grey soil)
Trunk detail (distinctive hexagonal 'honeycomb' pattern formed by old leaf scars)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; high contrast between the deep black stalks and the bright green fronds; emphasis on the 'honeycomb' trunk texture; clear quadrant separation.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A large black coiled fiddlehead; Top-Right: Detail of the black stipe; Bottom-Left: A young sapling in volcanic ash; Bottom-Right: A high-detail view of the hexagonal trunk scars.
visual_logic.ground: Fine-grained light ash grey volcanic soil.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to ensure the black textures don't get lost in shadow.
